text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At first, I hoped that Wonder Acute
would simply
return to normal, as if
nothing happened at all.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Wheeze... Wheeze... Huff... Cough...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But it didn't take long to realize that was
just
wishful thinking. Reality isn't so
kind.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer dear... I just... can't
seem to get
my energy back...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's so strange. I know I have to do
something,
but... I just...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's not strange at all. As her trainer, I'm
well
aware of how her vitality is
withering away. This
is, in fact,
completely natural.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes... Sorry, dearie.
choice_data_list: とにかく焦らずにいこう

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There is still hope for recovery, however.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When an Umamusume carries a wish with
her that
she wants to make come true...

text_block_list.name: Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
Look! Lookie here, dearie! I can walk all
this way
all by myself now!

text_block_list.name: Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
And I've got you to thank for it!
Watching your
races inspired me to keep
working hard.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Is that right? I'm so glad to hear that.

text_block_list.name: Boxing Student
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Miss Acute! Everyone's been real
fired up
after seeing that big race of
yours!

text_block_list.name: Boxing Student
text_block_list.text:
Now they're all dreaming about winning
a belt
one day! That goes for me too, of
course!
Hehehe!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You don't say. I'm looking forward to
seeing you
win that title, dear.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, Trainer. I may have fallen short
before, but I
seem to have reached
everyone this time.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I've done an ample job being
the pillar
that supports their comeback
attempts.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And that makes me believe that pushing
myself so
far was well worth it. Yes,
indeedy...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When an Umamusume carries a wish with
her,
she'll rise to the occasion.
However...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her wish is already coming true.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On February 17, during a live
broadcast...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I have an announcement to make for all
my fans.
Recently, I received a very
special invitation...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So I, Smart Falcon, will be stepping
away from the
Twinkle Series to
compete in an international G1
in
Dubai! ☆

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Ohhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Falco...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're caught completely unawares by
Smart
Falcon's announcement about
Dubai.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone remembers last year, right?
Both dirt
and turf runners were invited to
compete in
Dubai.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And the results were fantastic! An
unbelievable
one-two finish!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But it was a turf Umamusume who took
first...
even though dirt runners are
supposed to have
the advantage on that
track.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty sure things'll be different this
time,
though... You know why?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Because Flash and I are gonna reverse
that
one-two finish! With me in first
place, naturally!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I will also be competing. But please
note
that I have no intention of placing
second.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
This may be my final chance to have a
certain
someone witness me emerge
victorious.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
So, Smart Falcon, you'll be joining from
among
the dirt racers? And Eishin Flash
from the turf
racers?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
But how will the Twinkle Series fare in
your
absence? Especially the dirt races.
Will they really
be okay without y—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
They'll be fine. I used to think I needed
to be here
to lead everyone along, but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
There are people who can take over for
me now! I
can head off to Dubai with a
clear conscience!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon has decided to race
alongside her
German-born roommate,
Eishin Flash, in Dubai.
Which means...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She won't be here for Wonder Acute to
challenge.
She won't be here to motivate
her.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I see... So Falco is going far away, too...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
She's moving on to the next stage. And
well...
Listen, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps this is for the best. These old
bones
aren't doing as they're told
anyway...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
So what's the use in rushing things?
Maybe I
needn't push myself so hard...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All of a sudden, something about
Wonder Acute's
expression seems
different.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's always had a "nice old lady" vibe
to her, but
now...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We keep training in an attempt to get
her back
into form, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That should about do it. I think a
short
break is in order.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fancy some crunchy munchies, dearie?
Go on,
have a bite.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Let's get us some energy and give the
Kashiwa
Kinen the old college try.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her recovery hasn't progressed well at
all... And
that reckless desire to shine
seems to have
dissipated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The world continues to change around
Wonder
Acute... but will she change
along with it, or will
she let it pass her
by?
